module-power-distribution.name: Power Distribution Panel
module-power-distribution.description: Distributes contracted power to modules. Route capacity and headroom limit safe load.

module-vacuum-tube-logic.name: Vacuum Tube Logic Module
module-vacuum-tube-logic.description: Performs basic operations. It produces substantial heat and benefits directly from clock speed and cooling.

module-arithmetic-unit.name: Arithmetic Unit
module-arithmetic-unit.description: Concentrates numerical operations. It provides high compute but needs power, control and fast routes.

module-control-unit.name: Control Unit
module-control-unit.description: Coordinates operation order and reduces penalties for serial and latency-sensitive tasks.

module-accumulator-register.name: Accumulator Register
module-accumulator-register.description: Stores intermediate results near compute. It offers low latency with limited capacity.

module-delay-line-memory.name: Delay-Line Memory
module-delay-line-memory.description: Provides more capacity through recirculating pulses. It enables larger workloads but requires stable timing.

module-punch-card-reader.name: Punch Card Reader
module-punch-card-reader.description: Loads data from cards. It is robust but limits bandwidth-heavy tasks.

module-paper-tape-reader.name: Paper Tape Reader
module-paper-tape-reader.description: Provides faster input and simple buffering for sustained streams.

module-line-printer.name: Line Printer
module-line-printer.description: Delivers large result batches. It uses space and power but reduces output bottlenecks.

module-data-relay.name: Data Relay
module-data-relay.description: Extends and organizes routes. It reduces congestion and long-connection penalties.

module-air-mover.name: Industrial Air Mover
module-air-mover.description: Directs airflow across nearby modules and reduces local hotspots.

module-room-cooling.name: Room Cooling Unit
module-room-cooling.description: Extracts heat from the facility. It consumes significant power but supports sustained loads and overclocking.

task-ballistic-table-verification.name: Ballistic Table Verification
task-ballistic-table-verification.description: Verify a trajectory set and deliver the results before the contract deadline.

task-census-tabulation-service.name: Statistical Tabulation Service
task-census-tabulation-service.description: Continuously process record batches. Payment depends on sustained throughput.

task-wiring-layout-study.name: Wiring Layout Study
task-wiring-layout-study.description: Compare routes and latency for a modular system layout.

task-reactor-diffusion-study.name: Numerical Diffusion Study
task-reactor-diffusion-study.description: Iteratively solve a model with high memory, precision and stability requirements.

task-aerodynamic-load-matrix.name: Aerodynamic Load Matrix
task-aerodynamic-load-matrix.description: Calculate many independent cases inside a short window. Parallelism and Boost can help.

task-prime-number-survey.name: Prime Number Survey
task-prime-number-survey.description: Run a long serial search that rewards stable clock speed and low latency.

task-semiconductor-effect-analysis.name: Semiconductor Effect Analysis
task-semiconductor-effect-analysis.description: Clean experimental measurements and fit a model for a solid-state device.

task-stored-program-demonstration.name: Stored-Program Demonstration
task-stored-program-demonstration.description: Load instructions into memory and execute a complex program without fully rewiring the machine.

research-stable-power-distribution.name: Stable Power Distribution
research-stable-power-distribution.description: Improves headroom measurement and enables higher-load arithmetic units.

research-vacuum-tube-reliability.name: Vacuum Tube Reliability
research-vacuum-tube-reliability.description: Uses failure logs to reduce retries and support centralized room cooling.

research-forced-airflow.name: Forced Airflow
research-forced-airflow.description: Unlocks industrial air movers and the heatmap needed to locate hotspots.

research-accumulator-design.name: Accumulator Design
research-accumulator-design.description: Improves register timing and prepares delay-line memory.

research-delay-line-memory.name: Delay-Line Memory
research-delay-line-memory.description: Unlocks higher-capacity memory for multi-stage projects.

research-buffered-io.name: Buffered Input and Output
research-buffered-io.description: Reduces time lost while loading and delivering large data batches.

research-modular-wiring.name: Modular Wiring
research-modular-wiring.description: Unlocks data relays and auto-routing for cleaner paths.

research-blueprint-documentation.name: Blueprint Documentation
research-blueprint-documentation.description: Standardizes subassemblies and enables saving and replication.

research-high-frequency-clock.name: High-Frequency Clock
research-high-frequency-clock.description: Unlocks Manual control and the peak benchmark. It requires stable power and cooling.

research-transistor-theory.name: Transistor Theory
research-transistor-theory.description: Connects solid-state data with system results and completes the vertical slice.
